Hair loss recovery is one of the most debatable topics on the social media now days. There are two schools of thoughts which are currently present regarding this. One thinks that thinks that the only form of recovery that a hair fall victim can get is hair transplant and this is the only viable option left once the hair are lost. Second one on the other hand thinks that the hair recovery is possible by trying to find the root cause of hair loss and then eliminating it. As true as it that both of these arguments have sufficient evidence to support their hypothesis, one can never select one to be better than the other.

Hair loss recovery is possible from natural means to some extent only. The major inhibition in this case is the fact that the viable hair follicles once lost cannot be revoked and hence there are negligible to almost no chances of hair growing back from those follicles. But there are some hair which get thin with the passage of time as the growth inhibiting factor is present at large in the scalp specifically and in the whole body generally. In this case eliminating the root cause will help these hair to thicken and then recovery of the hair in this particular region is anticipated.
